messages:
Aya: Heads-up: compliance asked for stronger surfacing when routing/quota changes impact billing or tenant reach. They want a console flag + ability to jump to the exact export line.
Ben: We should avoid heavy sync logic on the commit path. Option A: synchronous compute and write severity. Option B: write minimal event, run lightweight enrichment job that patches the audit index.
Sam: +1 for async enrichment. Console can show a provisional state. But we need a way for export consumers to know if they saw the pre-enrichment or post-enrichment row. Add `audit.enriched=true/false` and `audit.enriched_at` fields.
Noor: Agree. Also propose a small `impact_tags` array: ["billing","multi-tenant","privileged-route"] so external SIEMs can map quickly without recomputing. Keep it optional to reduce payload size.
Aya: Good. Security: any tags that imply PII (like affected_tenants) must obey redaction param on export. Idea: allow `scope=full|masked` on export API. `masked` returns tenant_count instead of IDs.
Ben: For streaming webhooks we can emit two events: `audit.created` and later `audit.enriched`. Consumers who need final values can subscribe to enriched events. But we must rate-limit enrichment updates for noisy churn.
Sam: On rate-limits: add `enrichment_update_quota` per-tenant, maybe 5 updates/min. We'll drop updates into an async queue with dedupe for the same event_id within window.
Noor: Docs/SDK: add `?include_enrichment=true` param for `/v1/audit/events` and a header `X-Audit-Redaction: full|masked`. Avoid adding a new endpoint.
Aya: UI copy: show badge states - grey "pending", yellow "medium", red "high". Also tooltip: "This change affects billing/tenants — export evidence". Clicking goes to presigned NDJSON slice for that event.
Ben: Presigned link rules: 1) TTL=2min by default, extendable to 15min for admins, 2) one-time use token bound to session, 3) logs emitted when consumed.
Sam: For daily NDJSON exports we should embed enrichment metadata per-line: `enrichment_state`, `enrichment_at`, `impact_tags` and `masked_affected_count`. Consumers can request full IDs via a separate `get_event_details` endpoint only if they have `audit:full` permission.
Noor: API sample (inline):
```
{
  "id": "evt_001",
  "ts": "1720004321",
  "actor": "u_901",
  "action": "quota_change",
  "enrichment_state": "complete",
  "enrichment_at": "1720004400",
  "impact_tags": ["billing"],
  "masked_affected_count": "3"
}
```
Ben: Nice. Consider `impact_score` numeric 0-100 so customers can tune alerts. But that's more research. Maybe for v2.
Aya: Operational checklist: - feature-flag enrichment pipeline - add `enrichment_state` to schema as optional - console reads it and falls back to diff-size heuristic for older events - export accepts `scope` header and `include_enrichment` param - presigned link behind `audit_presigned_links` ff.
Sam: I'll prototype the enrichment worker (dedupe + compute impacted tenants by diff). Noor can own API docs and SDK changes. Ben will add redaction support in exporter.
infra-bot: Scheduled job created: `audit-enrich-worker` sandbox run tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
Noor: Final note: please add telemetry events `audit.ui.badge_shown`, `audit.api.export_presign` and track redaction choices. We need metrics to show compliance teams adoption.
Aya: OK, will open RFC and rollout plan today. Thanks all.
